output.reason: [ev-4139b0de79e3] says the exposed environments are those where the CRDs are installed separately, but it does not say how that shows up in configuration (for example a chart values key that turns CRD installation off, or a marker on the CRD objects). The proposed condition can't be accepted. It uses an undecidable leaf with the reason "environment-visibility-gap", which is not an allowed reason. Its stated rationale, that the configuration might not be visible, is exactly what undecidable must never be used for. To write the exposure predicate, we need upstream text that names the setting or object state marking a separate CRD install; until then the honest result is "undetermined", which a correction can't express.
